questions.q: According to lesson 1, what has become the most valuable asset?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says that under the technology ideology, data is what nations fight for.

questions.q: Why does lesson 2 call our sense of knowledge dangerous?
a: We think we know much more than we really do
We rely on too few experts
questions.why: Lesson 2 says we believe we have lots of knowledge, but we rely on others for nearly everything.

questions.q: What example shows how much we depend on other people's knowledge?
a: We can't hunt, build shelter or make clothes ourselves
questions.why: The summary notes we rely on many experts for daily life.

questions.q: What should schools teach, according to lesson 3?
a: How to think and navigate information
questions.why: Lesson 3 says school should teach how to think, not what to think.

questions.q: Why won't future workers need to know as much as possible?
a: More data is created each year than in past millennia
questions.why: The summary points to the flood of new data making navigation skills more important.
